component.name: Codex Native
component.summary: A native Codex desktop client for Arch Linux

description.p: Codex Native is a GTK4 and libadwaita client for Codex. It provides task history, streaming conversations, approvals, syntax-highlighted code and diffs, isolated Agent Workspaces, a VTE terminal, scheduled tasks, plugins and tools, native Linux Computer Use, Qwen Buddy local delegation controls, voice, and experimental pairing with ChatGPT on iOS. Repository operations are handled by the installed GitHub plugin or another user-chosen Git tool.

Markdown is rendered with native GTK text tags and Pango. The application does not use Chromium, Electron, or Tauri. One lazy, isolated WebKitGTK surface provides same-window ChatGPT Pro chat and Voice; Codex tasks, Markdown, diffs, and the rest of the interface remain native GTK.

Removes Native's source-control, pull-request, review, commit, synchronization, and worktree surfaces. Scheduled tasks now run directly in their selected folders, and Native is independent of the official Codex desktop application's release checks.
Repository operations remain available through the installed GitHub plugin or another user-chosen Git tool.

Expands Native Macro Execution with compact output previews and durable handles, content-aware read caching, conditional DAG steps, hash-checked atomic writes and patches, dry-run mutation plans, and exact follow-up output reads.

Adds p50/p95 latency, cache, artifact, context-avoidance, and app-server token-category telemetry while preserving the networkless command sandbox, normal approval handling, and ordinary-tool fallback for unsupported or adaptive work.

Keeps user and assistant messages durable when long-running turns exceed the live activity cap, and keeps canonical-history recovery active while other visible workspace pages are open so returning to Chat cannot expose a stale partial transcript.

Restores missing Native and iOS conversation history when the stock Codex paginated-history projector skips a rate-limit record and leaves its SQLite cursor permanently behind. Native now detects only the proven neutral-record gap, creates a consistent database backup, and repairs the rebuildable shared projection in one guarded transaction without modifying the canonical rollout.

The active Native transcript also merges a bounded read-only view of the canonical rollout, follows live iOS appends, survives task switching, and preserves richer server-projected tool and image cards. Recovery work runs off the GTK thread and is fingerprinted, bounded, and skipped safely when Codex changes its database schema.

Retires the version-coupled patched Remote Control router. Native and iOS now use the official managed Codex host directly, so Codex updates no longer require rebuilding or activating a matching custom binary.

Task Auto mode is now Qwen Assist: it preserves the task's selected Codex model, reasoning, speed, sandbox, and approval settings while selecting one eligible bounded Qwen Buddy subagent lane when available. Manual mode keeps work with Codex. Model-router profiles, automatic effort changes, the Sol Max lock, router services, patches, and build tooling have been removed.

Repairs iOS and Native transcript convergence for paginated tasks. Token-usage records now deserialize safely, stale history cursors rebuild from the canonical JSONL transcript, and indexed reads catch up before serving pages or search results.

Native falls back to an explicit bounded history request when a resume response omits its initial page and refreshes the open task after remote turn completion. Routed binaries now carry exact version, patch, commit, and binary provenance so an older same-version package can never be mislabeled as a newly patched router.

Adds task multi-selection with select-all/clear controls and fast bulk archive, restore, and confirmation-gated deletion. Selected rows remain visually and accessibly distinct while normal open-task highlighting and right-click pinning continue to work unchanged.

Repairs bounded resume for multi-gigabyte legacy tasks whose latest valid compaction and turn context occur inside one exceptionally long turn. The router now resumes from that canonical checkpoint without scanning the turn's full historical prefix or increasing its 128 MiB memory-safety budget.

Router source caches are keyed by both Codex version and reviewed patch revision, so same-version Native fixes always build from a clean checkout. The task bar warns when append-only history reaches 1 GiB, and recovery wording no longer falsely claims that no compaction exists.

Auto Max Savings now treats a selected Qwen lane as a required first local subagent when its safety contract can be satisfied. Safe coding turns can delegate their highest-value bounded investigation or one-file proposal to Qwen Sol before Codex integrates and verifies the wider change; desktop and routed iOS turns share the policy.

Per-turn zero-inference receipts now include successful Qwen usage from hidden numeric MCP metadata. The conservative estimate counts locally generated output ChatGPT did not generate plus condenser context kept out of Codex, while excluding failed calls and unobservable reasoning or input savings.

Makes Qwen Buddy available to bounded tasks in every project under the user's Projects and Documents/Codex roots while preserving its read-only, scoped-agent, test-allowlist, and secret-exclusion boundaries.

Adds a local-only receipt after each newly completed turn. It shows a conservative potential token-savings estimate against Sol Max using available app-server telemetry; the receipt is never inserted into the prompt, conversation protocol, or model context.

Bounds legacy and paginated history loading, streams projection batches, drops scanned Linux file-cache pages, unloads idle task and MCP state after a short grace period, trims glibc arenas, and applies protective Remote host memory and swap limits. New tasks use paginated history; giant legacy tasks resume from a recent verified compaction or offer a memory-safe continuation without consuming inference.

Replaces Auto Saver with two explicit per-turn policies. Balanced routes only among appropriate ChatGPT 5.6 models and reasoning levels. Max Savings begins from cheaper ChatGPT routes and can select exactly one bounded Qwen Luna, Condenser, or Sol lane when scope, risk, plugin readiness, and GPU capacity permit. Desktop and iOS use the same policy, legacy Saver state migrates automatically, and Ultra remains manual-only.

Streamlines feature parity into Check & Analyze: official DMG discovery, caching, inventory reuse, semantic delta analysis, and report validation continue automatically when needed. Users still explicitly select features and approve installation.

Splits upstream release probing from local protocol refreshes so an unchanged DMG inventory is reused even when the Codex schema changes. Changed DMGs are streamed and hashed once into a private two-release, four-GiB cache. A bounded normalized delta feeds Luna Max, and semantically unchanged checks reuse the existing validated report.

Keeps the optional Remote Control pre-turn router synchronized with the managed Codex installation. A low-priority user service watches exact official release tags, verifies the reviewed patch, normalizes only workspace lockfile placeholders, runs the focused router tests, and atomically publishes an exact-version binary. Activation waits for all observed turns to become idle; failed or incompatible builds keep the stock host online and retry with bounded backoff.

New profiles enable iOS pre-turn routing by default, while per-task Manual mode still preserves the iOS model selection. Terminal app-server events now clear every local running marker so completed tasks cannot retain a stale sidebar spinner.

Adds an opt-in native Macro Executor on the existing shared app-server. Validated dependency graphs batch bounded reads, searches, atomic writes, and argv commands; independent reads run concurrently, mutations use sorted file or workspace locks, and MCP cancellation stops the execution tree. Commands run without network, host home, or credentials inside bubblewrap and transient user-systemd memory, process, output, and time limits. Only explicitly saved project roots are accepted.

Adds prompt-free A/B telemetry for normal versus macro-assisted app-server turns, including completion, tokens, elapsed time, tool-call count, and available peak-memory measurements. The bounded private ledgers never retain prompts, task IDs, paths, source, commands, or output. The feature remains disabled by default while measurements are collected.

Fixes Lean Context pressure accounting to use the current model window instead of the cumulative thread total and suppresses automatic retries when a compaction reports no reduction. The task bar now shows current tokens, window capacity, percentage, and cumulative thread tokens separately. Stop clones its active thread and turn identifiers before mutating request state, preventing the prior RefCell crash.

Adds opt-in pre-inference routing for prompts sent through ChatGPT iOS Remote Control. The routed host preserves the original thread, text, images, attachments, sandbox, and approval data while applying each task's Auto or Manual model policy before turn submission. Manual and disabled policies pass through unchanged, corrupt policy fails open to the stock request, automatic routes never select Ultra, and a version guard falls back to the official host after upstream updates until the isolated patch is rebuilt. The Remote host now runs as a supervised foreground user service with automatic crash recovery. Adds an idempotent one-shot weekly-limit reset guard with a headless watcher that can protect active tasks without restarting an older GUI session, plus low-memory isolated routed-host builds.

Adds per-task Auto and Manual routing controls with Balanced and Max Savings profiles, a reversible manual Sol Max lock, prompt and runtime escalation, shared Desktop/iOS settings, and visible per-turn route receipts. Automatic routes use Standard speed and can never select Ultra; Ultra remains an explicit manual choice.

Adds the Lean Context Engine for long tasks: guarded same-thread automatic, prompted, or observe-only rollover; private structured checkpoints; configurable hard evidence and output budgets; hash-aware evidence reuse; deterministic exact-rehydration rules; and measured checkpoint, compaction, and token-reduction telemetry. Desktop and iOS keep one thread identity and raw app-server history remains available.

Large safe source, text, and log files can use the installed Qwen Buddy read-only condenser with a bounded target and cited evidence. Codex remains the sole writer and final verifier. Checkpoint hashing is off the GTK thread, private files use restrictive permissions, and compaction is blocked during turns, approvals, disconnection, or duplicate work.

Makes Desktop/iOS continuity self-healing. The shared managed socket now uses a ten-second WebSocket heartbeat, declares silent connections stale after thirty seconds, times out orphaned status requests, and reconnects with bounded backoff instead of leaving either UI stuck. Native watches daemon RAM, swap, and event-database pressure; after two unhealthy checks it safely restarts the remote host when every task is idle, with a five-minute recovery cooldown.

Makes task navigation and streaming substantially lighter. Compact history starts in parallel with resume, each task resumes only once per transport connection, late responses cannot replace the currently open task, and stale inactive history is discarded. GTK drains backend events in bounded batches and coalesces task-list rebuilds, preventing a burst of live tool events from monopolizing the main loop. Remote Access also reports host memory pressure and warns when the older Electron client is concurrently creating duplicate app-server state.

Makes upstream feature-parity checks automatic: one confirmation discovers the current macOS app from OpenAI's official download page, pins the artifact origin, records transport identity, computes SHA-256, and reuses an unchanged inventory in under a second. The CI inventory now runs daily without copied URLs, checksums, or version fields.

Improves responsiveness and memory use by lazily loading extensions, apps, Qwen, and diagnostics; using state-database reads for recurring history reconciliation; bounding retained transcript data; and replacing continuous GTK frame-clock spinners with one low-frequency activity clock shared by all running-task indicators. Extensions opens with the compact installed/local catalog and loads the large remote catalog only when requested. Apps render in searchable 24-card pages. Task history loads compact conversation summaries before hydrating detailed activity one turn at a time, and exceptionally large frames are drained without reconnecting the shared Desktop/iOS Remote transport.

Keeps Native, the managed Codex daemon, and paired iOS clients on one stable app-server connection. Remote status and paired-device refreshes now share Native's persistent WebSocket, duplicate health checks are coalesced, relay status changes refresh immediately, and every managed client closes with a WebSocket close frame. This removes the recurring connection churn that left stale subscribers in the daemon and delayed cross-device task updates. Full task-list reconciliation now runs every two minutes instead of every remote-health tick, while server events and network-return refreshes keep cross-device changes immediate.

Adds native Projects, Pull requests, Sites, and Scheduled sidebar surfaces. Pull requests uses the authenticated GitHub CLI read-only, Sites prepares an unsent website task and opens its existing plugin, and Scheduled exposes the systemd-backed automation workflow under the current Codex product label. WebKit internal documents such as about:srcdoc remain inside ChatGPT instead of opening a desktop application chooser. Remote Access now reads status and paired devices from the managed remote-control daemon, and the task speed picker maps the server's internal default tier back to Standard. While Remote Access is enabled, Native now uses that same managed app-server transport as paired iOS clients, receives their live thread events, and resumes the open task after reconnecting instead of creating a separate session. Managed WebSocket reads now remain intact while UI requests are sent, preventing escalating reconnect loops; recovery resumes the open task first and performs only a lightweight state refresh.

Adds pasted image and file attachments, Enter-to-send, stable incremental transcript rows, sparse completion merging, and task-scoped model, reasoning, speed, sandbox, and approval controls. Periodic history refreshes now preserve the open task, and repeated send and navigation cycles maintain a bounded memory plateau. Large remote plugin catalogs load lazily and render with a fixed native-card cap.

Resumes persisted tasks before starting a turn, preserves the active task across paginated history refreshes, anchors the transcript scroll position, and coalesces live transcript rendering for a more responsive interface. Image activity now includes clickable previews and file changes include direct editor actions.

Adds a guarded native Update Center for checksum-verified macOS release inventories and feature-parity work. GPT-5.6 Luna with Max reasoning produces a validated, selectable report; approved low- and medium-risk features are implemented only in an isolated Git worktree. Fixed compiler, lint, test, release-build, and Arch-package gates block installation on failure. Verified local packages require explicit Polkit approval and are retained for rollback.

Restores task history, the live account model catalog, weekly usage, and reset-credit data while Remote Control is enabled by separating the native UI's shared app-server transport from the managed remote host. Adds a native StatusNotifier tray with close/minimize-to-tray, Show, and explicit Quit actions; Light through Ultra reasoning plus Standard/Fast speed controls; in-app ChatGPT Pro and Voice; resumable goals with stop reasons; far-right running-task activity rings that track turns across local Codex clients; spawned-agent counts and statuses; and a strong highlight for the open task. Adds a resizable, collapsible, independently scrollable Chat-to-Settings workspace menu. Redesigns the native transcript with a readable content width, live step and diff progress with a full-plan hover tooltip, clickable image activities with a native gallery, compact collapsible activity rows, dark-theme code and diff views, and a calmer composer.

Adds native Qwen Buddy plugin health, qualified-model and GPU-pressure telemetry, conservative local token and context-savings reporting, opt-in Luna, file-condenser, and bounded Sol routing with an automatic game-engine GPU guard, and a dedicated read-only OpenCode VTE terminal.

Adds bounded transcript memory, live weekly usage and reset credits, Git and worktree workflows, isolated Agent Workspaces, AppShots, Record and Replay, voice, automation history, native diagnostics and Arch updates, remote recovery, and a verified macOS parity-inventory pipeline.
Adds plugin lifecycle management, MCP authentication and forms, and Linux Computer Use readiness, policy, and setup controls.
